invariants.rationale: If b is not zero, integer division and modulus reconstruct a, otherwise division not evaluated.
For all nonzero b, b may not be Integer.MIN_VALUE if special handling is required for edge-case division.
Parameter a is an int, and so lies within int bounds.
Parameter b is an int, and so lies within int bounds.
For positive b, integer division result is less than or equal to a; safe because b == 0 is guarded.
